title: of the GitHub “php2shell” Repository: Public PoCs and Defense Tools That Spread Immediately After the Disclosure of the PHP Vulnerability
content_md: Overview Immediately after the PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 were disclosed on October 21, 2026, a large number of repositories named “php2shell” were created in a short period of time on GitHub, a code repository platform. Of the top 100 repositories (excluding forks) found by searching for “php2shell,” 99 addressed these vulnerabilities, and nearly all […]
